description: This file defines a helper class 'CodeHelper' for managing codes and code values within the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting codes and their values via REST API calls, intended for use in integration testing. The class also provides utilities for generating JSON payloads and interacting with the Fineract client library.

classes.name: CodeHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to manage codes and code values through REST API interactions within integration tests. It includes methods for CRUD operations, retrieval by name or ID, creation of specific code types, and JSON payload generation.

methods.name: createCode
methods.description: Creates a new code with specified name via POST request to the server.

methods.name: updateCode
methods.description: Updates an existing code identified by codeId with new data.

methods.name: getCodeById
methods.description: Retrieves details of a code by its ID.

methods.name: getCodeByName
methods.description: Finds and returns code details matching the given codeName.

methods.name: getOrCreateCodeValueByCodeIdAndCodeName
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a code value for a given code ID and name.

methods.name: retrieveOrCreateCodeValue
methods.description: Checks for existing code value by codeId and creates it if absent.

methods.name: getAllCodes
methods.description: Fetches all codes from the server.

methods.name: getAllCodeValuesByCodeId
methods.description: Fetches all code values associated with a specific code ID.

methods.name: getSystemDefinedCodes
methods.description: Returns system-defined codes from the server.

methods.name: getTestCodeAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON payload for creating a code with the specified name.

methods.name: getTestCodeValueAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON payload for creating a code value with given attributes.

methods.name: deleteCodeById
methods.description: Deletes a code identified by codeId.

methods.name: createAddressTypeCodeValue
methods.description: Creates a code value for address type codes.

methods.name: createStateCodeValue
methods.description: Creates a code value for state codes.

methods.name: createCountryCodeValue
methods.description: Creates a code value for country codes.

methods.name: createChargeOffCodeValue
methods.description: Creates a code value for charge-off reasons.

methods.name: createCodeValue
methods.description: Creates a code value for a given code ID.

methods.name: getCodeValuesForCode
methods.description: Retrieves code values for a specific code.

methods.name: getCodeValueById
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific code value by IDs.

methods.name: deleteCodeValueById
methods.description: Deletes a specific code value.

methods.name: updateCodeValue
methods.description: Updates details of a specified code value.

methods.name: retrieveCodes
methods.description: Retrieves all codes via Fineract client.

methods.name: retrieveCodeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a code object by its name via Fineract client.
